extractor_change_policy: any change to the fn-extraction or macro-detection regex in scripts/mode-a-contract-check.cjs MUST bump EXTRACTOR_VERSION there AND this field AND refresh this census in the same commit (the gate asserts equality). Scope note (post-audit correction): the assertion couples version and census freshness; it does NOT detect a regex edit that leaves extraction output unchanged - the census inventory check is the real tripwire, keep it honest. v1 = pub/async-only (R12-E1). v2 = qualifier set const|async|unsafe|extern before fn (r12-wave-f D-003). v3 = post-audit tighten (r12-wave-f fixup): extern accepts bare or quoted abi with optional whitespace both sides (extern"C"fn is legal Rust); macro assertion now also covers leading #[attr], pub(..) visibility, and space-tolerant macro_rules !. Residual limits (verbatim): single-line definitions only; glued non-extern idents like constfn are identifiers not declarations; the macro assertion covers DEFINITIONS only, never invocation sites (name!(..)).
line_count_convention: content.split(\n).length on the raw file bytes (no trim); the script's warn-only line report uses the same expression and reads the frozen figure from frozen_at, never a hardcoded number
residual_limits: Known extractor blind spots NOT visible to the v3 fn regex (enumerated per r12-wave-g D-001, independent-audit residual finding): (1) same-line #[attr] fn - an attribute on the same line before fn defeats the anchored fn match; (2) glued extern { fn } - a fn written on the same line as its extern block opener is not at line-start and is missed (fns on their own line inside an extern block are still caught). Status: 0 occurrences of either form in port_forwarder.rs as of 2026-09-25 (grep-verified). If either form is ever introduced the census function inventory MUST be hand-verified in the same commit - the gate cannot count these shapes and the macro fail-closed assertion does not cover them. Cross-ref: census extractor AST upgrade row in docs/agents/trigger-line-register.md.
registered_legislation: Mode A is a legislated dataplane (ADR-0068 D1/D3), not drift. Boundary law = protocol-family freeze + no TLS fronting + no new L7 features. Trigger line: docs/agents/trigger-line-register.md row 'Mode A shell forwarder boundary law' - net-new dataplane behavior (new handshake dialect / new rewrite rule / new StreamSensor dimension) re-opens adjudication; a deliberate change updates this file in the same commit.
adr_0068_d4_verbatim: HTTPS/TLS fronting of entry ports is explicitly out of scope for this decision.
